name: Modern Farmhouse — raised pool (rough)
note: Farmhouse variant: pool on a stone-walled deck 1.8 m above the courtyard with broad steps up. The west wing is now an upper-floor pool house joined to the view storey, its roof valleyed into the main upper roof; bifolds open to a terrace with steps down to the pool deck. Lawn over most of the deck; short rear eave for ground-floor sun. Earthworks figures are still the original farmhouse's.
